sources.snippet: RecToM is a benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the Theory of Mind (ToM) capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) within recommendation dialogues. LLMs must infer users' Beliefs, Desires, and Intents during multi-turn interactions—skills essential for building context-aware and effective recommender systems.

sources.title: [2511.22275] RecToM: A Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Theory of Mind ...
sources.snippet: To better align LLM-based ToM evaluation with human-like social reasoning, we propose RecToM, a novel benchmark for evaluating ToM abilities in recommendation dialogues. RecToM focuses on two complementary dimensions: Cognitive Inference and Behavioral Prediction.
